executive_summary: 今日正式 RadarReportV2 為 partial/live_multi，共 205 件合格項目（135 Major、70 Potential）；品質閘門有效但總項目與 Major 都超過人工複核門檻，因此本次解讀把它視為高覆蓋候選池，而不是 205 個彼此獨立且等權重的市場結論。
美國 7 月非農就業減少 2.3 萬人、失業率 4.1%，勞參率降至 61.4%，且 5、6 月合計再下修 10.3 萬人；勞動市場轉弱已從單月雜訊升為需要觀察的宏觀傳導訊號，但通膨仍將限制聯準會的政策空間。
台灣 7 月出口仍年增 32.9% 至 753 億美元，AI 相關需求維持支撐，但增速低於 6 月的 40.3% 且不及市場預期；台灣 AI 供應鏈更適合用『高成長但邊際降速』閱讀，而不是把強勁出口直接外推為全面內需繁榮。
AI 供應鏈的伺服器、記憶體、封裝與光通訊需求仍強，但正式事件池同時出現『OpenAI Astra／ChatGPT 6』等未獲 OpenAI 官方支持的二手敘述；官方目前公開產品主線仍是 GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra、Luna，因此相關 Astra 事件在本分析降為不確定性。
Retail canonical domain 今日只有 6 件，而且包含時尚話題、文化內容與錯分的投資組合論文；同時九格 Retail matrix 幾乎全部 observed、social-commerce 格甚至引用 376 個 signal，顯示矩陣存在跨域關鍵詞灌入，不能把其 observed 狀態解讀為營運資料完整。
競品固定監測完成 20/21：91APP 與 Workato 出現官方材料變化、WACA 固定來源因 HTTP 405 全部失敗。外部補搜可讀到 WACA 官方 POS/OMO 頁，但這只補足『可查』而非證明今日有新產品；91APP AgentOne 與 Workato MCP 則顯示企業 Agent 正朝任務執行、Workflow、API/MCP 與治理能力靠攏。

key_findings.label: ai_inference
key_findings.title: 美國 7 月就業轉弱，政策焦點由單純抗通膨轉成成長與通膨的雙重約束
key_findings.summary: 正式報告已捕捉 7 月非農減少 2.3 萬人的事件；BLS 原始發布進一步確認失業率 4.1%、勞參率 61.4%、零售業就業減少 1.9 萬，且 5、6 月合計下修 10.3 萬。短期會降低市場對立即升息的把握，但不能僅憑一次就業報告推論政策轉向，仍需與 7 月 CPI、薪資與後續勞動數據合併判讀。

key_findings.label: background
key_findings.title: 台灣 7 月出口維持高成長，但已出現高基期下的邊際降速
key_findings.summary: 外部補搜的 Reuters 報導台灣 7 月出口年增 32.9% 至 753 億美元，仍由 AI 需求支撐，但低於 6 月 40.3% 與市場預估。這是對今日台灣曝險的重要補充，未對應 RadarReportV2 event，因此不冒充正式事件。

key_findings.label: uncertainty
key_findings.title: 正式事件池的 OpenAI『Astra／ChatGPT 6』敘述缺乏官方佐證，應降級而非放大
key_findings.summary: 正式報告收錄二手來源稱 OpenAI 將釋出 Astra、甚至達關鍵網攻門檻；但 OpenAI 官方產品與新聞頁目前公開的是 GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra、Luna，未找到 Astra 正式發布。這兩件事件可以保留為待查線索，但不能當成已驗證的新模型或安全分級事實。

key_findings.label: ai_inference
key_findings.title: AI 基建需求繼續向伺服器、記憶體、封裝測試與光互連擴散
key_findings.summary: 緯創 AI server、SK hynix 新廠投資、創見高階記憶體與 OSAT 漲價等事件指向同一條供應鏈：需求不只落在 GPU，而是擴散到伺服器整機、HBM/記憶體、先進封裝、測試與光互連。下一步要驗證的是利用率、交期、ASP、CapEx 與自由現金流，避免把擴產本身當成已實現的利潤。

key_findings.label: uncertainty
key_findings.title: Retail 今日有事件，但固定矩陣的 observed 範圍明顯大於真實零售證據
key_findings.summary: canonical Retail 僅 6 件，其中真正接近營運的案例有限；官方台灣最新零售資料仍停在 6 月。與此同時 Retail matrix 多格引用數十到數百個 signal，顯示跨域詞彙把非零售事件灌入。今日零售應保留『有局部品牌/通路案例、營運 KPI 仍不足』的結論。

key_findings.label: ai_inference
key_findings.title: 弱就業推升比特幣價格，但穩定幣總供給尚未顯示同步的廣泛 risk-on 擴張
key_findings.summary: 正式報告捕捉比特幣在弱於預期的美國就業數據後突破 6.5 萬美元；DefiLlama 同日快照則顯示穩定幣總市值約 3,005 億美元、7 日僅增約 0.2%、30 日仍約減 0.74%。因此價格反彈與系統性流動性擴張不能畫上等號。

key_findings.label: ai_inference
key_findings.title: 91APP 與 Workato 的材料變化指向同一競爭方向：從資料/整合層走向可治理的任務執行層
key_findings.summary: CompetitorAuditV1 標記 91APP 與 Workato 為 updated。補搜顯示 91APP AgentOne 已公開 Workflow Builder、Skill Marketplace、API/MCP Integration 與 Agentic Management Center；Workato MCP 則提供企業工具連接、身分追蹤與稽核。對 RetailOps 的威脅不是單一 AI 聊天功能，而是既有資料、Workflow 與執行治理被平台整合。

future_trends.title: AI 基建由擴產競賽進入利用率與變現效率競賽
future_trends.summary: 3 個月：伺服器、記憶體、封裝測試與光互連需求仍可能維持強勢，價格與交期先反映供給緊張。6 個月：若新增產能的利用率、ASP 與自由現金流未跟上 CapEx，市場將更明顯區分『需求真實』與『投資回收不成立』的公司。
counterevidence: 消費電子與部分非 AI 終端需求仍可能疲弱，且供應限制或政策禁令會抑制實際出貨。
uncertainties: 部分 AI server、Oracle 訂單與供應鏈投資來自產業媒體或市場傳聞，正式訂單金額與持續期仍待公司公告。
next_watch: 伺服器 ODM 月營收與 AI 比重
客戶集中度與取消/延後訂單

future_trends.title: 美國勞動降溫與通膨風險並存，消費與政策進入更窄的走廊
future_trends.summary: 3 個月：弱就業、低勞參與與薪資增速放緩會提高市場對寬鬆政策的期待，但能源與其他價格風險仍會限制政策彈性。6 個月：若就業持續疲弱而通膨無法同步下降，零售與中價品牌將面對需求和成本的雙重壓力；若通膨快速回落，則實質可支配所得可能改善。
counterevidence: 單月非農變動本身噪音高，且失業率仍只有 4.1%；就業下降部分受地方教育季節因素影響。
uncertainties: 7 月 CPI 尚未發布，聯準會政策反應不能只由就業數據推定。
next_watch: 美國 7 月 CPI 與核心 CPI
零售業就業與實質薪資
消費者支出與信用卡拖欠
零售商同店銷售與促銷深度

future_trends.title: 企業 Agent 競爭將由回答品質轉向 Workflow、權限、稽核與跨系統執行
future_trends.summary: 3 個月：MCP、Workflow Builder、Skill/Tool registry、身分與稽核能力會更常被打包進企業 Agent 平台。6 個月：具備既有 POS/ERP/CRM 資料與前線工作流的平台，可能把 Agent 從建議層推進派工、核准、追蹤與回報，直接壓縮純分析型 RetailOps 工具的差異化空間。
counterevidence: 平台公開文件證明能力存在，不等於客戶已大規模採用或能處理跨品牌複雜營運規則。
uncertainties: 91APP/Workato 的本日材料變化可能包含網站改版，尚未證明今天發布特定新功能或新價格。
next_watch: 任務執行成功率與人工介入率

supplemental_evidence.title: The Employment Situation — July 2026
supplemental_evidence.summary: BLS confirms nonfarm payrolls changed little at -23,000 in July, unemployment was 4.1%, labor-force participation 61.4%, retail trade employment fell 19,000, and May/June payrolls were revised down by a combined 103,000.

supplemental_evidence.title: Taiwan July exports misses forecasts, but AI demand remains solid
supplemental_evidence.summary: Reuters reports Taiwan July exports at US$75.3 billion, +32.9% year over year, still supported by AI demand but below June's 40.3% growth and the analyst consensus.

supplemental_evidence.title: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
supplemental_evidence.summary: OpenAI's current official model release names the GPT-5.6 family as Sol, Terra and Luna. No official Astra product release was found in the current OpenAI product/news pages, so report items asserting an Astra/ChatGPT 6 launch remain unverified.

supplemental_evidence.title: 115年6月批發、零售及餐飲業營業額統計
supplemental_evidence.summary: MOEA reports June retail turnover of NT$421.3 billion, +8.0% y/y; department stores +8.9%, e-commerce/mail order +7.3%, convenience stores +3.2%. July official retail turnover was not yet published in the current statistics dashboard at fetch time.

supplemental_evidence.title: Stablecoin Market Cap Chart, Supply & Peg Data
supplemental_evidence.summary: DefiLlama current snapshot shows total stablecoin market cap about US$300.5 billion, +0.2% over 7 days but -0.74% over 30 days, with USDT dominance about 61.0%. This does not indicate a broad new liquidity surge despite Bitcoin's post-jobs-data rebound.

supplemental_evidence.title: AgentOne 是什麼？零售與餐飲品牌如何讓 AI Agent 從問答走向任務執行
supplemental_evidence.summary: 91APP describes AgentOne as an enterprise AI Agent platform connected to Commerce Cloud, Marketing Cloud and iCHEF data/workflows, with Agentic Management Center, Skill Marketplace, Workflow Builder and API/MCP Integration.

supplemental_evidence.title: WACA POS｜整合店面與電商的無限商機，全通路掌握顧客
supplemental_evidence.summary: The WACA product page is publicly discoverable despite the fixed monitor's HTTP 405 failures. It states POS/e-commerce integration, cross-channel membership and inventory synchronization, more than 50,000 brand merchants and NT$0 entry pricing; this restores visibility but does not prove a same-day product update.

supplemental_evidence.title: MCP | Workato docs
supplemental_evidence.summary: Workato documents MCP as an enterprise bridge from AI models to databases, APIs and business applications, with multi-region availability; related MCP documentation describes identity tracking, audit/compliance and support for MCP-compatible clients.

limitations: RadarReportV2 status is partial. FreshRSS credentials are unavailable, and web/API/social adapters plus external discovery/collection inbox were not executed by the formal collection composition.

The formal sources_not_executed list still includes BLS, IMF, IEA, DefiLlama, TWSE, FSC, CBC, MOL, MOEA, Legislative Yuan, Executive Yuan, Laws & Regulations DB, Commercial Times, CryptoCity and FreshRSS collection. Supplemental evidence only fills selected public gaps and does not change RadarReportV2 evidence.

Competitor monitoring is incomplete: WACA's two fixed official URLs both returned HTTP 405. External web discovery can read WACA pages, but this is a fallback visibility check rather than a successful fixed-monitor audit.

The report contains 205 items and 135 Major items, above review thresholds of 180 and 90. Cross-source semantic deduplication and low-transmission Major review remain necessary before treating event counts as independent signals.

Retail matrix quality is weak: only 6 canonical Retail events exist while several matrix cells reference dozens to hundreds of signals, including social_commerce_content_discovery_ai_referral=376. Matrix observed status therefore overstates operational evidence coverage.

Crypto matrix also shows broad observed coverage despite DefiLlama and other fixed sources not being executed; price/news keyword hits should not substitute for ETF flows, stablecoin supply, RWA, perp OI/funding, TVL/fees and Taiwan fixed-source data.

All three deterministic structural indicators are saturated at support=100 and counter=100 with confidence=100. Those immutable values are preserved, but the conflict indicates keyword/evidence saturation rather than perfect certainty.

Two formal OpenAI Astra-related items are not corroborated by current OpenAI official product/news pages. They remain source-report events but are explicitly downgraded to uncertainty in the interpretation layer.

The daily built-in AI analysis was deterministic fallback and failed the production AI gate because provider/model were missing and fallback was forbidden; this chat-assisted analysis is a separate validated interpretation of the same report, not a replacement report.
